name: Paraneoplastic Isolated Brainstem Encephalitis

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Proposed Paraneoplastic Brainstem Encephalitis Diagnostic Criteria

criteria.description: Subacute onset of brainstem neurological symptoms including dysarthria, diplopia, and ataxia
Detection of paraneoplastic antibodies (e.g., anti-Hu, anti-Ma2) in serum or CSF
MRI evidence of isolated brainstem inflammation without other CNS involvement
Identification of underlying malignancy within 5 years of neurological symptom onset
CSF pleocytosis or elevated protein supportive of inflammatory process

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of subacute brainstem neurological symptoms plus detection of paraneoplastic antibodies and MRI evidence of brainstem inflammation
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires exclusion of infectious, metabolic, and other autoimmune causes.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Diplopia due to cranial nerve palsies
searchTerms: seeing two images due to eye muscle weakness
diplopia caused by cranial nerve problems
numbness or tingling in arms or legs

rare.symptomName: Respiratory failure due to brainstem involvement
searchTerms: difficulty breathing due to brainstem injury
respiratory arrest caused by brain problems

laboratory: Presence of paraneoplastic antibodies (anti-Hu, anti-Ma2, anti-Ri) in serum or CSF
imaging: MRI showing T2/FLAIR hyperintensity localized to brainstem without supratentorial involvement
other: Identification of underlying malignancy (commonly small cell lung carcinoma or testicular germ cell tumor)

distinguishingFeatures: MRI diffusion restriction consistent with infarction
Positive infectious agent PCR or culture
Fever and systemic signs of infection

redFlags: New onset cranial nerve palsies with systemic malignancy
references: Dalmau J, Rosenfeld MR. Paraneoplastic syndromes of the CNS. Lancet Neurol. 2008;7(4):327-340.
Graus F, et al. Updated diagnostic criteria for paraneoplastic neurological syndromes. Neurology. 2021;96(8):e1017-e1027.
Lancaster E. The diagnosis and treatment of autoimmune encephalitis. J Clin Neurol. 2016;12(1):1-13.
